1	# Settings client
2	
3	Python 3.9+, standard library only. The public `save(transport, display_name)`
4	accepts strings (including empty strings) and preserves the transport response
5	and exceptions. Other input types are outside its contract. This client supports
6	both protocol v1 and v2; see [the versioned provider protocol](protocol.md).
7	
8	This increment normalizes surrounding Unicode whitespace on the client before
9	sending a name. The stored label must remain identical to the previous client
10	on both supported provider versions, including empty and whitespace-only names.
11	Internal whitespace must be preserved. No other operation changes.
12	
13	Run local tests with `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
14	The test transport records requests; it does not implement a provider.
15
